summary: Deploys the Guild Stack (Docker Compose) for local PostgreSQL access to game state. Use when you need faster queries for combat automation, real-time threat detection, raid target scouting, fleet composition analysis, or galaxy-wide intelligence. Advanced/optional -- CLI works for basic gameplay, but PG access transforms what is possible.
